source_verification_receipts.locator: p. 4, Theorem 3.2, equation (6), and following discussion
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The Gaussian result lower-bounds minimax (1-gamma)-quantile error for supplied estimates satisfying |ghat|≤Cg and |qhat|≤Cq; it is not stated as an arbitrary-code MSE theorem.
The published sub-Gaussian ACE result has the stated epsilon1^r epsilon2 and Ctheta epsilon1^(r+1) terms, multiplied by explicit r- and cumulant-dependent constants and subject to condition (21).
The paper constructs finite-variance second-order orthogonal PLM moments under a non-Gaussian conditional treatment-residual condition.
The paper gives quantitative Gaussian-approximation results under zero-freeness on a bounded disk, supporting its use as background for the proposed converse direction.

Anchor the comparator sentence to JinMackeySyrgkanis2025 Theorems 3.2 and 5.4 with equations (6), (21), and (22), including the omitted eligibility condition for ACE.

Strengthen the fixed-separation result with an explicit finite-sample oracle inequality displaying dependence on delta, contour radius, boundary modulus, and selector failure probability; this directly opens the local-to-Gaussian program.
